title: Breakglass audit event v1
description: One audit event: a Kafka record value, a webhook single-event body, or one element of a webhook batch's events array. The log sink flattens events into log fields and is not covered. See docs/audit-event-schema.md. Within v1 only additive changes are made: consumers must ignore unknown properties. The type enum lists the event types of this schema revision; quarantine a record with an unknown type and update the schema instead of dropping it.

id.description: Unique event ID; stable across delivery retries. Deduplicate on it.

schemaVersion.description: Envelope schema major version. Absent on events of releases before the schema was published; treat absence as v1.

type.description: Event type; selects the details payload. Only the event types of this schema revision are valid: a new type is added to the schema before it is emitted.

timestamp.description: When the event occurred (RFC 3339, nanosecond precision).

details.description: Event-type-specific payload; see $defs per event type.

user.description: User identifier: email, username, service account, or "system" for controller actions.

identityProvider.description: Identity provider that authenticated the user.

groups.description: Verified group claims of the user.

sourceIP.description: IP address of the request origin.

uid.description: Immutable Kubernetes UID of the target, when known.

clusterUID.description: Immutable UID of the referenced ClusterConfig.

namespaceLabels.description: Labels of the target namespace, when known.

correlationId.description: Request correlation ID; groups the events of one API request or terminal stream.

sessionUID.description: BreakglassSession UID (or DebugSession UID for debug-session events).

sessionLifecycle.title: Breakglass session lifecycle
sessionLifecycle.description: Details of BreakglassSession lifecycle events. Correlate by requestContext.sessionUID.

ticketSystemID.description: Ticket or incident reference supplied with the request.

escalationName.description: Escalation that the session was requested through.

reason.description: Reason code or free-text reason supplied with the decision.

expirationReason.description: Why the session expired, for example timeExpired or approvalTimeout.

terminalState.description: Terminal state recorded by duplicate-session cleanup.

terminalDecision.description: Terminal decision of a session.termination_intent event.

transitionCommitted.description: True when the status transition was committed before the event was emitted.

scheduledStartTime.description: Requested start of a scheduled session. RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when unset.

actualStartTime.description: Actual activation time of a scheduled session. RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when unset.

sessionApprovalUnverifiedGroups.title: Approval on unverified groups
sessionApprovalUnverifiedGroups.description: An approval was authorized on JWT-claim groups because the cluster-side group lookup failed.

groupBasis.description: Basis of the group decision. Known values are listed in examples; accept others.

loadBearing.description: True when the unverified group decided the approval.

authorization.description: Authorization outcome. Known values are listed in examples; accept others.

debugSessionLifecycle.title: Debug session lifecycle
debugSessionLifecycle.description: Details of DebugSession lifecycle events. Correlate by requestContext.debugSessionUID.

residuals.description: Identities of resources left behind by a failed cleanup; null or empty when none were identified.

debugSessionWorkload.title: Debug session workload
debugSessionWorkload.description: Debug pod health and deployed-resource events. The envelope target is the Pod or resource.

last_termination_reason.description: Reason of the last container termination.

debugSessionNodeMaintenance.title: Node maintenance
debugSessionNodeMaintenance.description: Synchronously delivered intent and result receipts of a node-maintenance operation. The event id is <operationID>-intent or <operationID>-result.

approvedAt.description: Approval time. RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when unset.

result.description: Operation result; empty in the intent.

bootID.description: Node boot ID observed by the operation.

restartPods.description: Pod selectors restarted after a service restart.

restartedPodUIDs.description: UIDs of the Pods the controller restarted.

hostUnchanged.description: True when the host was verified unchanged.

debugSessionAdmissionRecipe.title: Admission recipe
debugSessionAdmissionRecipe.description: Synchronously delivered admission-recipe receipts. The event id is <operationID>-<stage>.

approvedAt.description: Approval time. RFC 3339 timestamp, or null when unset.

debugSessionHotfix.title: Hotfix
debugSessionHotfix.description: Synchronously delivered hotfix receipts. The event id is <operationID>-intent/-result or <node operation>-intent/-result.

payload.description: Full approved hotfix payload (debug_session.hotfix.intent only); mirrors DebugSession spec.hotfix.payload.

type.description: Payload kind. Known values are listed in examples; accept others.

mode.description: Edit mode. Known values are listed in examples; accept others.

nodes.description: Node count (intent) or per-result node counts (result).

terminalRecording.title: Terminal recording
terminalRecording.description: Recording lifecycle. Carries recording identity, integrity digest, size, completeness and retention; never terminal bytes.

recordingId.description: Recording identifier (artifact ID). Use it to request replay through the Breakglass API.

operation.description: Terminal operation. Known values are listed in examples; accept others.

complete.description: True when the stream ended normally and authority still held.

streamError.description: Set when the stream was aborted.

abortReason.description: Bounded reason code of an aborted stream. Known values are listed in examples; accept others.

stage.description: Failed stage. Known values are listed in examples; accept others.

terminalRecordingAccess.title: Terminal recording access
terminalRecordingAccess.description: An authorized reader listed or replayed recordings.

access.description: Access kind. Known values are listed in examples; accept others.

accessDecision.title: Access decision
accessDecision.description: Authorization webhook decision for one SubjectAccessReview.

podSecurity.title: Pod security
podSecurity.description: Pod security evaluation of an exec/attach/port-forward target.

overrideApplied.description: True when an override allowed the request.

impersonation.title: Impersonation
impersonation.description: Authorization decision for an impersonation request.

impersonationConstraint.description: Constrained impersonation verb; empty for legacy, as in the API server audit log.

identityResource.description: Impersonated identity resource (users, groups, serviceaccounts, uids, userextras).

legacyFallbackWarned.description: True when a legacy fallback warning was issued.

generic.title: Unstructured details
generic.description: Reserved event types, declared but not emitted, without a structured payload. The published schema accepts any object; the strict CI variant accepts none, so a type must get a structured definition before it is emitted.
